text: With `--max-query-len`, the bytes past the cap are don't-care, so any order of suffixes whose first `max_query_len` characters are equal is a correct sort. dev's merge sort (`merge` in `libsufr/src/sufr_builder.rs`, at c69cc0a) does not produce the same order from run to run: on chr1 with `-m 16`, runs with different `-t` and `-n` wrote three different `.sufr` files, none with an out-of-order key, so differing bytes between two builds do not show an error.
